subject: English
question_text: Choose the correct answer from the following alternatives: 1 ✕ 7 =
stimulus: i. Who warns Sonabhan about her rooster? (a) The village head (b) Her neighbor’s son (c) The old Chowkidar (d) The Chowkidar’s young wife ii. What does Sonabhan do to punish Moti after the warning? (a) She beats him (b) She gives him less food (c) She grounds him (d) She sells him at the market iii. How does Moti react to being grounded? (a) He becomes aggressive (b) He gets excited (c) He falls asleep (d) He becomes sad iv. What is Sonabhan’s response when the boys offer money to borrow Moti for cockfighting? (a) She agrees for a high price (b) She scolds them (c) She asks for time to decide (d) She refuses, calling Moti her son v. What does Sonabhan find on Monday morning? (a) Moti has flown away (b) Moti has gone missing (c) Moti has died (d) Moti has laid eggs vi. Where does Sonabhan bury Moti? (a) Behind the kitchen (b) In the field (c) By the river (d) Beside her husband's grave vii. What unusual thing happens the next day? (a) The ducks stop quacking (b) The coop breaks open (c) Sonabhan’s doors stay shut (d) Ameen returns from training
